fields.sql: WITH `p0` (`c0`, `c1`, `c2`) AS (SELECT `s0`.`id` AS `c0`, FIRST_VALUE(`s0`.`id`) OVER (ORDER BY `s0`.`id` ASC GROUPS BETWEEN 40000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `c1`, LAG(`s0`.`id`, 1, 999999999) OVER (ORDER BY `s0`.`id` ASC) AS `c2` FROM `phase66`.`phase66 part` AS `s0`) SELECT `t1`.`c0` AS `id`, `t1`.`c1` AS `low`, `t1`.`c2` AS `high` FROM `p0` AS `t1`
